scoring_justification: Checker recomputes total yield strength as sum of component strengths and compares each field to paper-reported gold values with generous tolerances; deterministic fixed-input calculation allows exact_match tolerance scoring.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported strengthening contributions and yield strength for WQ Ti-2.8Cr-4.5Zr-5.2Al alloy
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text (interface strengthening ~421 MPa), experimental yield strength 1266 MPa, Supplementary Note 7 for other contributions; reference solve.sh uses these exact numbers.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper and its supplementary material; values consolidated into inline gold.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own computed/measured quantities, traceable to the publication; used as ground truth for reproduction verification.

outputs.description: Computed total yield strength and individual strengthening contributions for the water-quenched Ti-2.8Cr-4.5Zr-5.2Al alloy.

output_contract.notes: The task omits the diffusion distance calculation and phase-field simulation stages, as they are supporting analyses and not required for the main quantitative claim. The strengthening model evaluation is self-contained and verifiable by recomputing from the same microstructural parameters.
